Product Details: The Jugnu Solar Lightbox and Phone Charger L2005 is a versatile solution designed to provide reliable lighting and convenient charging capabilities wherever you go. Equipped with a 2.5W/5.5V polycrystalline solar panel, this lightbox charges efficiently in just 6-8 hours under direct sunlight, ensuring you have power when you need it most. With a 3.2V/3000 mAh LFP battery, the Jugnu L-2005 delivers impressive longevity across its 5 lighting modes. Whether you're using it as a reading light with 45 lumens for up to 24 hours, a bed light with 15 lumens for a remarkable 78 hours, or as a brighter source of illumination with 200 lumens lasting up to 6 hours in the brightest mode, this lightbox adapts to your needs. Additional brightness modes include 45 lumens of bright light lasting 24 hours, and 140 lumens of brighter light that lasts 9 hours. This versatility makes the Jugnu Solar Lightbox ideal for everything from gentle ambient lighting to powerful illumination during outdoor activities or power outages. Beyond lighting, this device also doubles as a phone charger, giving you peace of mind when you're off-grid. Compact, efficient, and powerful, the Jugnu Solar Lightbox and Phone Charger L-2005 is a must-have for those who need reliable light and power on the go.
